items.title: EXT-002 residue-driven repeat-error suppression probe (moral_amnesia analog, EXP-0526)
items.note: Fulfills EXP-0526 (backlog_id EVB-1247, claim EXT-002 -- "Hallucination: no persistent error residue accumulates to shape future outputs."). Dispatch brief named claim EXT-005 and this chip's own chip_ref title says EXT-005 -- both stale/wrong; direct lookup of proposal_id=EXP-0526 confirms claim_id=EXT-002 (EXP-0532 is the real EXT-005 proposal, separately claimed by another session). GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): no existing manifest or claim_evidence entry tags EXT-002 -- not recoverable, ran fresh. SUBSTRATE READINESS (2.5/2.5a): no v3_pending/implementation_phase gate on EXT-002/ARC-005/INV-006/INV-008; ResidueField.accumulate/evaluate_trajectory (ree_core/residue/field.py) and E3's composite scoring (f_weight*F + lambda_eff*M + rho_residue*phi, e3_selector.py:1386) confirmed live in source. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): no prior autopsy on EXT-002 -- brake does not fire. "Error" operationalised as harm (agent.update_residue's actual gate, harm_signal<0), not literal E1 loss -- the literal E1 prediction-error signal is used only as a P3 positive control on a throwaway agent, per the docstring's "WHAT IS ACTUALLY UNDER TEST" section. DESIGN: A0_INTACT (residue accumulates from harm, read via E3 argmin) vs A1_RESIDUE_FROZEN (field frozen at init, identical read path); DV = decline_gap = decline_A0 - decline_A1, decline = repeat_error_rate(early) - repeat_error_rate(late) over matched (grid_x,grid_y,action_class) revisit keys. C1 (load-bearing) decline_gap>=0.15pp, C2 effect >=0.80 SD paired cross-seed delta, C3 sign-consistency >=2/3 seeds, C4 min revisit count >=20 both halves both arms. DV-SYMMETRY: declared per-arm in docstring -- E3 argmin over residue-scored candidates, neither arm's manipulation is index-permutation/additive-constant/monotone-rescaling invariant (V3-EXQ-800 precedent). RED-TEAM (fable, Step 4.5): BLOCKING on first pass, fixed before queueing -- (1) CONFIRMED (verified by the queueing session against causal_grid_world.py source): _make_env never set contamination_spread, defaulting to 0.5, which manufactures harm on mere cell-revisit independent of residue (env's own docstring names this exact trap, V3-EXQ-513 precedent) -- fixed with contamination_spread=0.0 explicit. (2) CONFIRMED: half_point was computed from the PLANNED step budget, but health-death can truncate episodes early, permanently starving revisit_late -- fixed to split by REALIZED step count post-hoc. (3) CONTESTED->confirmed live risk, non-blocking: P2's positive-control measures the residue term in isolation, not the composite E3 score it's embedded in, so P2-green does not guarantee the freeze manipulation reaches behaviour -- mitigated by recording (not gating, no calibrated threshold exists) a same-seed A0-vs-A1 action-stream-divergence diagnostic in the manifest so a null C1 result can be told apart from instrument-never-engaged. Post-fix smoke run showed 0.0000 divergence at all 3 seeds, but at dry-run scale (30-60 steps vs full-scale's 60000) too few harm events accumulate for this to be conclusive either way -- flagged as an open empirical risk this run itself will resolve via the recorded diagnostic, not grounds to block queueing. (4) CONFIRMED: FLOOR_REVISIT_DENOMINATOR (P4, readiness) was literally equal to THRESH_C4_MIN_REVISITS (C4, verdict) -- tautological, and a WORKING residue effect (fewer late revisits because errors are avoided) would self-route to substrate_not_ready_requeue, discarding the very outcome that confirms the claim -- fixed by decoupling P4 (early-half-only, floor 5) from C4 (both-halves, floor 20, unchanged). Added P5 (harm_rate_not_saturated, ceiling 0.90, worst-case across a arm's seeds) as a general degeneracy guard routing any future saturation source to substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than a false verdict. Re-smoke-tested post-fix (--dry-run, 3 seeds x 2 arms): harm_rate no longer pinned at 1.0 for 2/3 seeds (0.74, 0.05; seed 123 still saturated at 1.00 -- P5 will catch this per-arm at full scale via worst-case-across-seeds aggregation rather than corrupting the verdict). validate_experiments.py --strict: exit 0, 0 non-conforming (1 advisory e3-exemption-backlog note, non-blocking -- migrate to the shared fresh_select.py helper as routine follow-up polish, not a defect). ASCII-clean. Sleep: not used, no SLEEP DRIVER line required. STEP 8.6 NOT PERFORMABLE FROM THIS BOX: ree-cloud-5 has no REE_assembly/coordinator.env -- entry lands on origin/main via this commit but needs a coordinator-capable box (the Mac) to POST /queue/add before the fleet can claim it; verify by snapshot survival (~5min phase3_queue_writer tick) or hand off per /queue-experiment skill Step 8.6. estimated_minutes derived from V3-EXQ-800's recorded elapsed_seconds=54984 over 12 cells (same env/CEM/warmup config, 4 arms x 3 seeds) -> ~4582s/cell x 6 cells (2 arms x 3 seeds) here = ~458min, rounded up for P3 probe overhead.

items.title: MECH-320 diagnostic: is v_t's floor-saturation (v_t_floor=0.05) gate-caused or v_raw-caused? (calmed P2 bed, seeds 42/43/45)
items.note: diagnostic (not evidence): characterizes WHY v_t sits at v_t_floor=0.05 in V3-EXQ-951's regime -- gate suppression vs low v_raw -- via a per-tick joint classification on already-exposed TonicVigor.get_state() (no ree_core change). Calmed P2 bed (scaffold_p2_num_hazards=0, scaffold_p2_proximity_harm_scale=0.0, scaffold_p2_hazard_food_attraction_guard=0.0) + seeds [42,43,45], per chip-20260901-mech320-noop-margin-dv-substrate's design (reproduced independently here; does not depend on that chip's own driver landing). GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): checked v3_exq_951_mech320_tonic_vigor_authority_sd054_20260830T125526Z_v3.json (uncalmed bed, seeds 42/43/44) -- seed 44's arms show v_t_mean=0.0500 with gate_product_mean=1.0000 (suggestive but not a per-tick joint test), while seeds 42/43 don't hit the floor at all (v_t_mean 1.3-2.6); that manifest records no per-tick series and is on the wrong bed/seed-set for this chip's question -- not recoverable, ran fresh. red-team (fable): CONTESTED, 4 findings (F1-F4), ALL FIXED prior to queueing, none waived. F1 -- a probe wrapping agent.select_action re-reads the SAME latched TonicVigor state on every non-E3 tick (agent.py:7138's short-circuit returns before compute_score_bias/update_score_receipt run at all), pseudo-replicating one real observation into many and silently inflating n_floor_hit past the sufficiency gate. F2 -- reading state post-select_action pairs v_raw (already advanced by update_score_receipt) against the PRIOR tick's last_v_t, a one-tick skew. Both fixed by wrapping tv.compute_score_bias directly instead: fires exactly once per genuine vigor computation, and reads state before update_score_receipt runs later in the same select_action call. F3 -- a pooled gate_caused_frac can mask cross-seed/cross-arm heterogeneity (one always-floored raw_caused seed swamping a rarely-floored gate_caused seed); now surfaced via heterogeneous_across_cells + a '_heterogeneous_across_cells' label suffix when any individual cell disagrees with the pooled classification. F4 -- P1 wasn't checked for .aborted like every earlier training phase, and the pool included seeds that failed the P1 survival gate (moribund-seed gate suppression leaking into a pool presented as survivors-only); fixed with a p1.aborted check routing to _fail, and _pool_p2_floor_stats now excludes unsurvived seeds (n_seeds_excluded_unsurvived reported). Re-smoke-tested post-fix (1 seed, --dry-run): rc=0, label=vt_floor_driven_by_low_v_raw, sufficient_floor_hit_sample met, heterogeneous=False. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings across all checks. Spawned by chip-20260901-mech320-vt-floor-diagnostic; complementary/non-blocking to the DV-redesign chip-20260901-mech320-noop-margin-dv-substrate (V3-EXQ-951b) -- either can land first. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (step 2.5b): fires on MECH-320 (5 counted substrate_ceiling/non_contributory autopsies) but is EXEMPT here -- this is a diagnostic whose purpose is to discriminate WHY the v_t-floor ceiling holds (gate suppression vs low v_raw), not a same-granularity lettered evidence re-test of MECH-320's selection-authority claim (that is V3-EXQ-951/951a/951b's job, not this script's -- see EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE="diagnostic" and evidence_direction="non_contributory" by construction).
